def save_proposal(content: str, index: int) -> Optional[Path]:
    """Save a proposal to the pending directory with deduplication."""
    # Create proposals directory if it doesn't exist
    PROPOSALS_PENDING.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    # Generate filename
    timestamp = datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
    
    # Extract proposal type and title from content
    lines = content.strip().split('\n')
    proposal_type = "learning"
    safe_title = "untitled"
    
    if lines and lines[0].startswith("# Proposal: "):
        title = lines[0][12:].strip()
        safe_title = re.sub(r"[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]+", "-", title)[:50].strip("-")
    
    # Try to extract type from content
    for line in lines:
        if line.startswith("**Type:** "):
            proposal_type = line[10:].strip()
            break
    
    filename = f"{timestamp}_{proposal_type}_{safe_title}_{index}.md"
    filepath = PROPOSALS_PENDING / filename

    # Deduplication: Check if similar content already exists
    content_hash = hashlib.md5(content.encode()).hexdigest()
    
    # Check existing proposals for similarity
    try:
        for existing_file in PROPOSALS_PENDING.glob("*.md"):
            if existing_file.exists():
                existing_content = existing_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
                existing_hash = hashlib.md5(existing_content.encode()).hexdigest()
                if content_hash == existing_hash:
                    print(f"[EXTRACTOR] Skipping duplicate proposal: {existing_file.name}", file=sys.stderr)
                    return None
                
                # Also check for high similarity (fuzzy matching)
                import difflib
                similarity = difflib.SequenceMatcher(None, content, existing_content).ratio()
                if similarity > 0.9:
                    print(f"[EXTRACTOR] Skipping highly similar proposal: {existing_file.name} ({similarity:.2%})", file=sys.stderr)
                    return None
    except Exception:
        pass  # Continue if deduplication fails

    # Ensure we don't overwrite
    counter = 1
    while filepath.exists():
        filename = f"{timestamp}_{proposal_type}_{safe_title}_{counter}.md"
        filepath = PROPOSALS_PENDING / filename
        counter += 1

    try:
        filepath.write_text(content, encoding="utf-8")
        print(f"[EXTRACTOR] Saved unique proposal: {filepath.name}", file=sys.stderr)
        return filepath
    except IOError:
        return None

The broader principle is that any learning system needs deduplication mechanisms. Without them, the system becomes noisy and loses credibility. Quality over quantity - it's better to have fewer, high-quality insights than many redundant ones.
